services.name: Ballet I (Ages 5-6)
services.desc: The next step for any dancer ages 7+ who has taken dance previously (for at least one year). Focus will be on dance etiquette, posture, and personal expression, as well as teamwork. Dancers will work on fast jumps, leaps, and turns as well as on slow and controlled movements. A perfect companion to the Wednesday evening Ballet/Jazz combo class (dual enrollment is not required). Please wear tights and a leotard with Ballet shoes. Boys can wear a t-shirt with pants or shorts and Ballet shoes. Long hair should be in a bun, braid, or ponytail.
